image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical etched patterns down the center and sides, a raised central ridge, and a horizontal slit near the neck opening. The surface is highly reflective, showing highlights from overhead lighting. A portion of the lower abdominal armor (fauld) is visible at the bottom.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types.
To analyze the realism of the reflections and etched textures, ensuring they don't exhibit AI 'smearing' or inconsistent lighting.
To verify the sharpness of the cut edges against the background and mannequin, checking for melting or halo artifacts.
To ensure the 3D curvature of the plate is physically consistent and not flattened or distorted.

focus_areas: Consistency of etched patterns (do they warp unnaturally?)
Reflection logic (do highlights match a single light source?)
Edge sharpness against the black mannequin
Structural plausibility of the neck opening and armholes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the etched patterns. In AI images, repetitive patterns often degrade or melt into each other. Verify if the patterns remain distinct and follow the 3D curvature of the metal correctly. Also, check the reflection on the left shoulder vs right shoulder for symmetry consistency.
